page.content:
Larry Hama's comic that serialized the Joe–Cobra war for more than a decade.

How G.I. Joe (Marvel comic) connects

  • Creator: Larry Hama — Larry Hama wrote Marvel's long G.I. Joe comic.
  • Work: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero — The Marvel comic adapts and extends A Real American Hero.
  • Character: Snake Eyes — Snake Eyes's silence and origin are central to the Marvel comic.

What is G.I. Joe (Marvel comic)?

Marvel's G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero, written largely by Larry Hama, is the long comic in which Snake Eyes's silence, Storm Shadow's Arashikage tie, and Cobra's civil wars became canon.

Key threads lead to Larry Hama, G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero and Snake Eyes.
